# Gitleaks huggingface-access-token: invented provider-shaped values. Fixtures
# are excluded from secret scanning, so shapes stay realistic. The token must
# be followed by a quote, space or end of text, so values are quoted.
# ruleid: huggingface-access-token
token = "hf_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefgh"
# ruleid: huggingface-access-token
token = "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"
# ok: huggingface-access-token
token = "example"
# ok: huggingface-access-token
token = "placeholder"
